([[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, Wisconsin]]) | college = [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] (2024–2025) | highlights = * Second-team [[List of All-Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball teams|All-ACC]] ([[2024–25 Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball season|2025]]) * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Freshman Team (2025) * [[ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] MVP ([[2025 ACC men's basketball tournament|2025]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2024) * [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]] (2024) }} '''Kon Knueppel II''' (born August 3, 2005) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]]. ==Early life and high school career== Knueppel grew up in [[Milwaukee|Milwaukee, Wisconsin]] and attended [[Wisconsin Lutheran High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2023/08/05/zach-kinziger-hopes-he-can-lure-kon-knueppel-to-wisconsin/70534584007/|title=Zach Kinziger hopes he can lure Kon Knueppel to Wisconsin|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=August 5, 2023|access-date=November 30, 2023}} He averaged 10.8 points, 4.7 rebounds, and 2.2 assists per game during his freshman season with the Wisconsin Lutheran Vikings.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-schools/2021/10/21/recruit-updates-wisconsin-2024-guards-kon-knueppel-nick-janowski/6116590001/|title=Recruit updates on Wisconsin 2024 guards Kon Knueppel, Nick Janowski|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=October 21, 2021|access-date=November 30, 2023}} Knueppel averaged 19.7 points, 9.2 rebounds, and 3.8 assists per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/college/uw/2023/06/11/kon-knueppel-patiently-evaluating-his-basketball-suitors/70310802007/|title=Kon Knueppel patiently evaluating his basketball suitors|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=June 11, 2023|access-date=November 20, 2023}} As a senior, he averaged 26.4 points, 8.8 rebounds, and 5.1 assists per game during the regular season and was named [[Wisconsin Mr. Basketball]].{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-school/2024/03/13/wisconsin-lutherans-knueppel-named-mr-basketball-by-wbca/72936996007/|title=Wisconsin Lutheran Duke commit Kon Knueppel named Mr. Basketball WBCA|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=March 13, 2024|access-date=March 17, 2024}} He helped Wisconsin Lutheran win the 2024 Boys Basketball Division 2 State Championship against Pewaukee and finish the season with a 30–0 record.{{cite web |title=2024 Boys Basketball Perfect Season |url=https://www.wlhs.org/news-detail?pk=1498911 |website=Wisconsin Lutheran High School |access-date=November 5, 2024}}{{cite web |last1=Knapinski |first1=Dick |title=Wisconsin Lutheran finishes perfect season with Division 2 championship against Pewaukee |url=https://www.wissports.net/news_article/show/1304240 |website=WSN |access-date=November 5, 2024}} ===Recruiting=== Knueppel was rated a five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] by [[247Sports]] and [[Rivals.com|Rivals]] and a four-star recruit by [[ESPN]].{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/virginia/basketball/five-star-recruit-kon-knueppel-schedules-second-official-visit-to-virginia|title=Five-Star Recruit Kon Knueppel Schedules Second Official Visit to Virginia|first=Matt|last=Newton|website=[[SI.com]]|date=July 14, 2023|access-date=November 30, 2023}}{{cite web|url=https://www.fayobserver.com/story/sports/college/acc/2023/09/21/duke-basketball-recruiting-kon-knueppel-cooper-flagg-jon-scheyer/70925425007/|title=What Kon Knueppel brings to Duke basketball's 2024 recruiting class|work=[[The Fayetteville Observer]]|date=September 21, 2023|access-date=November 30, 2023}} He committed to playing college basketball for [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] over offers from [[Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball|Alabama]], [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]], [[Wisconsin Badgers men's basketball|Wisconsin]], [[Notre Dame Fighting Irish men's basketball|Notre Dame]], [[Marquette Golden Eagles men's basketball|Marquette]], and [[USC Trojans men's basketball|USC]] among others.{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/38456601/no-22-recruit-kon-knueppel-commits-duke-basketball|title=No. 22 recruit Kon Knueppel commits to Duke web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/4887953/2023/09/21/duke-kon-knueppel-committment/|title=Duke lands commitment from 5-star wing Kon Knueppel: What this means for Blue the Blue Devils on November 15, 2023, during the early signing period.{{cite order to take part in the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Blue Devils]]' summer practices.{{cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/duke/basketball/duke-basketball-freshman-catches-fire-during-practice-7-4-24|title=Duke Basketball Freshman Catches Fire During Practice|first=Matt|last=Giles|website=[[SI.com]]|date=July 4, 2024|access-date=July 18, 2024}} He made his college basketball debut during Duke's season opener against Maine on November 4, 2024, and scored 22 points with four rebounds in a 96–62 win.{{cite web|url=https://www.newsobserver.com/sports/spt-columns-blogs/luke-decock/article295011199.html|title=Kon Knueppel steals the show from Cooper Flagg in Duke debut|first=Luke|last=DeCock|work=[[The News & Observer]]|date=November 4, 2024|access-date=November 5, 2024}} On November 11, 2024, Knueppel earned [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC) Rookie of the week honors, after averaging 18.5 points, 3.0 rebounds and 2.0 assists per game.{{cite web|url=https://theacc.com/news/2024/11/11/acc-unveils-first-mens-basketball-weekly-honors-for-2024-25-season.aspx|title=ACC Unveils First Men’s Basketball Weekly Honors for 2024-25 Season|date=November 11, 2024|publisher=[[Atlantic Coast Conference]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On December 21, 2024, Knueppel scored 18 points and 4 rebounds in a 82–56 win over [[Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets men's basketball|Georgia Tech]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724779|title=Knueppel scores 18 points as No. 5 Duke romps to 82-56 win over Georgia Tech|date=December 21, 2024|website=[[ESPN.com]]|publisher=[[Associated Press]]|access-date=March 19, 2025}} On January 7, 2025, Knueppel scored 17 points and 4 rebounds in a 76–47 victory against [[Pittsburgh Panthers men's basketball|Pittsburgh]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724757|title=Cooper Flagg and No. 4 Duke push past Pittsburgh 76-47 to stay unbeaten in ACC|date=January 7, 2025|website=[[ESPN.com]]|access-date=March 19, 2025}} On January 14, 2025, Knueppel scored 25 points and 3 assists in a 89-54 win over [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724800|title=Knueppel leads sharp-shooting attack as No. 3 Duke tops Miami 89-54 to stay unbeaten in ACC|date=January 14, 2025|website=[[ESPN.com]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On January 25, 2025, Knueppel added 15 points and 8 rebounds in a 63-56 victory against [[Wake Forest Demon Deacons men's basketball|Wake Forest]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724827|title=Flagg, No. 2 Duke push past Wake Forest 63-56 to stay unbeaten in ACC|date=January 25, 2025|publisher=[[ESPN]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On January 27, 2025, Knueppel scored 19 points and 6 rebounds in a 74-64 win over [[NC State Wolfpack men's basketball|NC State]].{{cite web|url=https://goduke.com/news/2025/1/27/mens-basketball-no-2-duke-surges-past-nc-state-74-64|title=No. 2 Duke Surges Past NC State, 74-64|date=January 27, 2025|publisher=[[Duke Blue Devils]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On February 1, 2025, Knueppel scored 22 points in a 87-70 victory against arch-rival [[North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball|North Carolina]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724844|title=No. 2 Duke jumps all over rival North Carolina, rolls to 87-70 win to stay unbeaten in ACC|date=February 1, 2025|website=[[ESPN.com]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On February 17, 2025, Knueppel added 17 points and 7 rebounds in a 80-62 win over [[Virginia Cavaliers men's basketball|Virginia]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724880|title=Flagg has 17 points and 14 rebounds as No. 3 Duke beats Virginia 80-62|date=February 17, 2025|publisher=[[ESPN]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On February 25, 2025, Knueppel scored 20 points and 5 rebounds in a 97-60 win against [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401724895|title=No. 2 Duke rolls past Miami 97-60, gets 25th win of the season|date=February 25, 2025|website=[[ESPN.com]]|access-date=April 10, 2025}} On March 15, 2025, Knueppel was named [[2025 ACC men's basketball tournament|ACC tournament]] MVP as he scored 18 points and 8 rebounds in Duke‘s 73-62 victory over [[Louisville Cardinals men's basketball|Louisville]] in the ACC championship game.{{cite web|url=https://apnews.com/article/duke-kon-knueppel-mvp-acc-7172e9cf5aff67a0d9757ecf6fe47426|title=ACC Tournament MVP Kon Knueppel proves Duke has firepower that goes well beyond Cooper evaluating all of his options |url=https://basketballrecruiting.rivals.com/news/four-star-kon-knueppel-evaluating-all-of-his-options |website=Rivals |access-date=5 November 2024}} He went to grade school and attends church at St. John’s Lutheran of the [[Wisconsin Evangelical Lutheran Synod]] in Wauwatosa, WI.{{cite web |title=Viking Christian Leaders: Humility |url=https://www.wlhs.org/news-detail?pk=1500364 |website=Wisconsin Lutheran High School |access-date=5 November 2024}} Knueppel's father, Kon, played college basketball at [[Wisconsin Lutheran College]] and was the school's all-time leading scorer until 2019.{{cite web|url=https://www.tmj4.com/sports/wisconsin-lutheran-basketball-star-upholds-his-family-name-as-15-schools-hope-to-recruit-him|title=Wisconsin Lutheran basketball star upholds his family name as 15 [[Gus Macker 3-on-3 Basketball Tournament]] as a team named the “Flying Knueppel Brothers”.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/469007/2018/08/12/its-like-a-basketball-family-out-there-an-oral-history-of-the-gus-macker-tournament/|title="It's like a basketball family out there" — an [[Green Bay Phoenix|Wisconsin-Green Bay]] and is the school's leading scorer.{{cite web|url=https://www.jsonline.com/story/sports/high-school/2022/12/09/wisconsin-lutherans-kon-knueppels-parents-were-basketball-stars-too/69711839007/|title=Wisconsin Lutheran's Kon Knueppel, a DI basketball recruit, is guided by parents who were stars as well|work=[[Milwaukee Journal Sentinel]]|date=December 9, 2022|access-date=November 20, 2023}} Knueppel's uncle, [[Jeff Nordgaard]], also played at Wisconsin-Green Bay and played in the NBA for the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] and professionally in Europe.{{cite
